description: This file defines a 'Node' class used for representing nodes in a tree view structure, including properties and methods for setting properties, adding child nodes, and retrieving node definitions.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a tree view, with properties for label, ID, href, child nodes, and methods for manipulating node data and structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Node instance with specified ID, label, and optional expanded state, generates a GUID for the node.

methods.name: set_property
methods.description: Sets a property or parameter for the node, which can be accessed in JavaScript.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node's children collection.

methods.name: get_definition
methods.description: Retrieves a multi-dimensional array defining the node's data, attributes, and child nodes, suitable for rendering in a tree view.
